claims: The USWNT is concluding a three-match April 2026 international window against Japan.
The final friendly is April 17, 2026, at 7:07 p.m. MT at DICK'S Sporting Goods Park in Commerce City, Colo.
The April 17, 2026 final friendly is broadcast on TNT, truTV, HBO Max, Universo, and Peacock.
USWNT vs. Japan on April 11, 2026 at PayPal Park, San Jose, CA.
USWNT vs. Japan on April 14, 2026 at Lumen Field, Seattle, WA.
USWNT vs. Japan on April 17, 2026 at 7:07 p.m. MT in Commerce City, CO.
USWNT vs. Colombia on March 7, 2026 in Harrison, NJ in the SheBelieves Cup
